title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL AGENT PERSONALITY AND RESPONSE APPROPRIATENESS: EVALUATION BY HUMAN LINGUISTIC EXPERTS, LLM-AS-JUDGE, AND NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING MODEL

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the personality assessments (introversion vs. extroversion) of an NLP transformer model and an LLM-as-Judge against evaluations by human linguistic experts to identify systemic skews toward assigning introverted traits due to imbalanced training datasets.
